## How to reproduce

Include the command, seed, version/model, relevant physical settings, and whether
you loaded a checkpoint or edited the world. Extinction or an unused ability alone
is not necessarily a bug.

## Environment

OS, GPU, driver, and the error message/log if available.

Do not attach personal paths or large checkpoints without checking their contents.
